method: Fifty genuinely distinct registered source areas were checked once at exact-model level, then each atomic field received a field-specific acceptance or rejection application. Public XHS was limited to search-engine indexes under shared-runtime coordination; no new XHS job, browser-profile bypass, login, CAPTCHA or security-verification action was attempted.
identity_note: The exact official China complete-bike page and exact R6 frameset page establish model identity. Retailer and owner-selected builds were kept separate from Hi-Light 航轮 R6 105 AL.

areas.note: The exact official page identifies the R6 105 AL and publishes CNY 8,300 retail, but its indexed content does not expose the complete component table or complete-bike weight.
The exact R6 frameset page publishes titanium construction, BSA, 27.2 mm seatpost, 12 mm thru-axles, mechanical/electronic compatibility and a 700×35C maximum.
The current manufacturer catalog indexes the exact R6 105 AL as a distinct complete bike.
